clips.title: The story
paras: At the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, Rema Schneider receives Harlan Bagley's request for fresh cloth and knitted goods. His shelves are emptying quickly.

Harlan Bagley asks Rema Schneider for a fresh supply of knitted garments and cloth. Bagley notes a sudden and unsettling surge in trade: citizens and travelers are buying armor and sturdy clothing as if bracing for a brutal season. The rush leaves Rema puzzled and wary. The House of Nobles has announced no open war, so Rema wonders why city folk are quietly armoring themselves and whether the crown's leaders are hiding unrest.
